title: Swain Action (Goal → Conflict → Disaster)
description: Classic Swain action scene: a concrete goal, rising conflict, and an unexpected disaster or setback.
systemPromptDirective: Drive the scene with high-stakes momentum, escalating conflict that resists the protagonist's goal, ending in an unforeseen disaster or setback.

fields.label: Immediate Goal
fields.placeholder: e.g., Extract the decrypted manifest before security reboots the subnet
fields.helperText: What the POV character desires right now (must be specific and immediate)

fields.label: Obstacle & Conflict
fields.placeholder: e.g., Automated turrets engage; an old rival intercepts the comms
fields.helperText: The active opposition, physical hazards, or opposing force preventing success

fields.label: Disaster / Setback
fields.placeholder: e.g., The terminal fries, destroying the manifest and sealing the blast doors
fields.helperText: Swain's disaster: 'No' or 'Yes, but...' outcome leaving the protagonist in worse trouble
